newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks close down in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks close down in light trading.

text.p: Colombian stocks, led by banking issues, receded in light trading on Thursday in sessions marked by the absence of foreign funds.
Medellin's IBOMED general price index fell 0.38 percent to 18,338.53 on turnover of 1.7 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index closed down 0.08 percent to 1,201.28 on turnover of 792 million pesos.
"There were practically no trades today," a Bogota broker said. "The foreign funds have become timid because the market hasn't shown a clear tendency."
One of the day's biggest decliners was Banco Industrial Colombiano SA, which fell 2.47 percent to 3,901 in Bogota.
Banco Santander Colombia ended 0.18 percent lower at 3,185 in Bogota and held steady at 3,180 in Medellin.
Cigarette maker Coltabaco SA fell 1.2 percent to 4,100 in Bogota and 3.54 percent to 4,003 in Medellin.
Brewer Bavaria SA finished up 0.12 percent at 8,190 in Bogota, but edged back 0.30 percent to 8,175 in Medellin.
